prompt: To prevent anonymous FTP users from listing uploaded file names, what precaution can be taken when creating an upload directory?
choices: The directory must not have the write permission set
The directory must not have the read or execute permission set
The directory must not have the read permission set
The directory must not contain other directories
The directory must not have the execute permission set
explanation: Removing read permission on the directory prevents listing its contents while still allowing uploads.
